name: Stock the Pantry
venue: New World Tawa,35 Oxford Street, Tawa, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Stock the Pantry
Once again we ask Tawa to come together to collect food and essential items for local families in need.

One in three New Zealand households experiences food insecurity, with food costs having risen 24% for a family of four since 2021.

The food bank in Tawa has been so busy and it’s not getting less.

Life continues to be hard on many families and our neighbours here in Tawa.
It’s a burden we often don’t see.

There will be the usual sausage sizzle and a team of amazing people to gratefully accept your donations and give out hugs!

Rotary- Inner Wheel and the Salvation Army will welcome you at New World Tawa!

Sponsored by Guardian Funeral home and in supporting Cans for a Cause - a national campaign that aims to collect 1 mum cans across New Zealand.

Thank you

Sonic Boom - A Family Concert Experience┃KĀPITI COAST
TICKETS 𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗔𝗟𝗘 4th of August

Introducing SONIC BOOM! After SELL OUT shows in upper North Island - we are hitting the road and heading to the Kāpiti Coast!

A high-energy live concert experience delivering the ultimate family night out! SONIC BOOM brings the excitement of a real rock concert to young audiences, packed with epic singalongs, huge dance moments, and nonstop fun.

Featuring some of New Zealand’s most experienced musicians, the band has decades of combined experience performing across New Zealand and around the world at festivals, major events, and live venues—bringing world-class musicianship and rockstar energy to every show.

Expect flashy guitar solos, bold costumes, big crowd interaction, and a show bursting with colour, surprises, and feel-good moments that kids (and parents!) will love.

The concert also stars 10-year-old drumming sensation Indy Monroe, fresh from performances at Christmas in the Park, Balloons Over Waikato, and the Americana Festival. Indy brings serious talent, big personality, and inspiring young-star energy to the stage.

Got a little one who loves to sing, dance, or air guitar? Come and give them an unforgettable first concert experience!

long_description:
NZ Bonsai Expo 2026
NZ's best bonsai, ceramics, suiseki, kusamono and accent plants on display. Live demos, competitions and vendors of all things bonsai.

About this Event

Themed 'From Raw to Refined', bonsai experts showcase making bonsai from raw stock plants and refining existing bonsai, sharing their skill, artistry and tips over a 2-day programme.
For info, programme and to register please visit www.nzbonsaiexpo.nz
Presented by the Wellington Bonsai Club.

long_description:
Cuba St Tavern Presents: Cian O'Donnell
CUBA ST TAVERN PRESENTS: WINTER SERIES

Next up: Cian

Friday 28 August | Doors 7pm

The Winter Series rolls on, and this round we're pulling in a genuine legend of Aotearoa's music culture: DJ, broadcaster, record shop owner, promoter and traveller Cian O'Donnell, who's been playing quality tunes for local ears since the late 1980s.

With one of Aotearoa's deepest record collections and decades spent behind the decks, Cian has built a reputation for sets that move effortlessly across genres. Whether he's playing to a packed dancefloor or a room full of mates, it's always about the next record - the one you didn't know you needed to hear.

Joining him is Jewel School, warming things up before Cian takes over for the evening.

Expect the kind of night that starts with a drink in hand, lets the room breathe, and slowly builds into a dancefloor.

Complete with immersive lighting from @lighterxx and sound powered by the custom Tubs Audio system.

📍 Friday 28 August
🕖 Doors 7pm
📍 Cuba St Tavern

🎟️ Tickets are on sale now!

Cuban Salsa Beginners Crash course
Always wanted to try Salsa but weren’t sure where to start? Or maybe you have done some dancing and want to return to it?
Good news— we have the right course for you!
Our Beginner Salsa Crash Course is the perfect introduction to Salsa, designed for absolute beginners. Over 6 hours of fun, structured learning. Master the fundamentals of Cuban Salsa in a supportive, and relaxed environment.
But Salsa is about more than just dancing. It's a fantastic way to reduce stress, boost your mood, improve confidence, and connect with others. The combination of music, movement, and social interaction has been shown to support mental wellbeing, helping you feel more energized, focused, and positive.
Whether you're coming on your own or with a friend, this crash course is a great opportunity to try something new, meet like-minded people, and discover why so many adults fall in love with Salsa.
